sys_hub_flow.description: This flow automates the Visa Case lifecycle. When a student creates a new Visa Case, the flow is triggered automatically. It assigns the case to an Advisor, sets the initial state to Open, sends a notification to the assigned Advisor, and prepares the case for the Advisor review process. This automation ensures every visa application follows a standardized workflow from submission through advisor review and subsequent processing.
